interpretation: The surcharge is 100 SP for the entire skill, not per learned rank. Threshold uses the character level of the first unlock.
distribution: Increasing positive integer costs across learned ranks; last rank most expensive. Preserve approved inexpensive starter unlocks wherever compatible. Further-rank character-level gates remain to be planned.
starterExceptions: Taming retains existing first costs and increases by one SP per further rank. Other approved starter first costs are preserved within the 300/400 total. Actual class totals are stored in full-skill-point-costs-by-class.json.

futureSkills.assignment: Wait for the user's skill list and required order, then distribute unlocks within the requested range while preserving that order.
futureSkills.budget: Additional to the current class budget; no new skills or unlocks generated now.

overworldSkillPointRewards: Not yet priced; no final lifetime cap of 10000 earned points.
